verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists a first-party Automations product (clickup-docs-14), and its developer docs say you can trigger workflows from ClickUp events (clickup-docs-3). Integrations also auto-create tasks on external events (Calendly, Salesforce) and connect to n8n for event-driven workflows. The evidence is only feature labels, though, with no description of how rules are defined, so the core is implied rather than shown. Missing for 10: documented trigger/condition/action rule builder, supported event and action catalog, AI-native rule authoring, independent or hands-on corroboration.
